services.name: Adult Snorkel Kit
services.desc: This event has multiple dates to choose from, please select the one you’re interested in attending to continue. Dive World private snorkeling lessons are a great way to learn how to use your snorkel gear in the safe and controlled environment of a pool, before heading out to the ocean. Designed for all levels of snorkelers, this course is a 90 minute session in the swimming pool with an instructor. You will learn how to properly fit and wear your mask, snorkel, and fins. As well as efficient kicking techniques, skin diving, and other skills that will make your ocean snorkeling experience more enjoyable.
